description: Master index mapping pipeline stages to playbook modules

topic_radar.usage: Score topic ideas against audience interest tests, breadth check, outlier potential

research_brief.usage: Ensure research covers audience pain points, goals, and curiosity triggers

story_validator.usage: Apply 4-test checklist: fresh perspective, originality, best option, title/thumbnail viability

script_generation.usage: Structure script with green/purple pattern, water tank pacing, but/therefore flow

script_enhancer.usage: Verify intro meets expectations, add curiosity gaps, check energy variation

check_fern_script.usage: Score script against playbook retention criteria in addition to Fern metrics

storyboard_generator.usage: Apply visual variety rules, plan B-roll density, attention guide techniques

director.usage: Energy variation, sound design layers, visual continuity, deliberate continuity breaks

video_assembler.usage: Enforce cut frequency, visual variety ratios, sound design density, color grading mood

title_generation.usage: Apply 26-tactic checklist, title word optimization, synergy with thumbnail

thumbnail_generation.usage: Apply spotlight elements, color psychology, 1-second scan test, composition rules

voice_generator.usage: Vocal delivery variation — louder for excitement, lower for suspense, pauses for anticipation
